editorial: You know that feeling when you have everything you ever wanted but still feel like something is missing? That is exactly where Shrek finds himself in this fourth adventure. He is a dad now, living in the swamp with Fiona and the kids, and he misses the days when people feared him. So when a smooth-talking deal-maker named Rumpelstiltskin offers him one day of feeling like a real ogre again, Shrek jumps at it. Big mistake. He gets tricked into a twisted version of Far Far Away where ogres are hunted, Rumpelstiltskin rules everything, and Fiona does not even know who he is. The setup is fun and surprisingly emotional, giving the story a fresh twist while still feeling like classic Shrek. The animation looks great, the jokes land well, and the action scenes keep things moving. On the downside, some of the magic from the first two films feels a little faded, and a few side characters do not get enough screen time. Still, it is a solid family movie with heart. You should watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: Shrek realizes the only way to break Rumpelstiltskin's contract is to get a true love's kiss from Fiona before sunrise. He fights through Rumpelstiltskin's army of witches and ogre hunters to reach her. Fiona, who has become a tough ogre resistance leader in this world, finally kisses him. The contract breaks, and Shrek wakes up back in his normal life with his family. He now appreciates everything he has and stops wishing for the old days.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated family adventures with heart and humor.
